vehicle.gvwr: Class 1: 6,000 lb or less (2,722 kg or less)

pids.0156: long term secondary O2 trim bank 1 (%)

signals.name: odometer
signals.verified: read against the dashboard one minute into a running log (142,934 mi), and again as +5 km over a 17-minute drive

signals.name: oil temperature
signals.verified: u16 big-endian, value*0.75-48. Tracks coolant closely on a real log (r=0.9896 at zero lag), which confirms it is a temperature on the engine but not by itself that it is the OIL temperature.
signals.source: decode from obd-gauge-cluster's curated F10 profile (src/vehicles/bmw_f10_535i.cpp, MIT); the identifier is in this project's own sweep on 7DF

signals.name: reference torque
signals.verified: 0.1 Nm per count, the live baseline 2258BA is a percentage of. Around 3989 counts on this engine.
signals.source: decode from obd-gauge-cluster's curated F10 profile (src/vehicles/bmw_f10_535i.cpp, MIT); the identifier is in this project's own sweep on 7DF

signals.name: oil pressure
signals.verified: ABSOLUTE, so barometric must be subtracted for gauge pressure. Reads 03E8-0410 with the engine off, which is 1000-1040 mbar -- atmospheric, which is what oil pressure at rest should be. That also explains a previous decode coming out about 15 psi high: skipping the barometric correction adds one atmosphere, 14.7 psi. Recorded earlier in this project as a MAP sensor, which was wrong.
signals.source: decode from obd-gauge-cluster's curated F10 profile (src/vehicles/bmw_f10_535i.cpp, MIT); the identifier is in this project's own sweep on 7DF

signals.name: crank torque
signals.verified: 0.1 Nm per count, u16. Expressed as a percentage against 224517, the live reference torque, rather than read as an absolute.
signals.source: decode from obd-gauge-cluster's curated F10 profile (src/vehicles/bmw_f10_535i.cpp, MIT); the identifier is in this project's own sweep on 7DF

source: obd-discover, 4 on-car capture(s) 2026-08; Mode-01 support scanned 2026-08-29
notes: 535i (F10). 2258xx and 224Axx are absent from the community list entirely. Enhanced Mode-22 reads in the 58xx block on the 7DF functional broadcast decode byte 0 only; a full u16 read there ingests NAK frames. That constraint comes from obd-gauge-cluster's profile and matters for anyone decoding 2258xx from a broadcast.
